basic.name: Groundbreaker (Q)
basic.description: Deal 81 damage to enemies in an area. Heroes hit on the outer edge are Stunned for 0.5 seconds and then Slowed by 40% for 2 seconds.

basic.name: Bloodthirst (W)
basic.description: Deal 156 damage to an enemy and heal for 10% of Garrosh's missing Health. Healing is increased by 100% against Heroes.

basic.name: Wrecking Ball (E)
basic.description: Throw a nearby enemy Hero, Minion, or Mercenary to the target location, dealing 91 damage to enemies near the impact and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

basic.name: Into the Fray (?)
basic.description: Activate to throw a nearby ally and grant them 20 Armor for 3 seconds. Deals 91 damage to nearby enemies upon impact and Slows them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.While in flight, allied Heroes are Unstoppable.

heroic.name: Warlord's Challenge (R)
heroic.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Decimate (R)
heroic.description: Deal 50 damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.Stores up to 3 charges.

trait.name: Armor Up (T)
trait.description: Garrosh gains 1 Armor for every 2% of maximum Health missing. {highlight}Taunting up to 1.5 seconds after a takedown heals Garrosh for 15% of his max health.{/highlight}
trait.developerCommentary: A brutal leader that wants to intimidate the enemy should have the possibility to do it.
subtexts: Enemies will have vision of Garrosh when he is taunting even if it's on cooldown.
This is the game taunt button which show mastery button not to be confused with Warlord's Challenge

1.name: Warbreaker
1.description: {quest}Quest:{/quest} Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker. {reward}Reward:{/reward} After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 damage over 3 seconds to Heroes. {reward}Reward:{/reward} After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

1.name: Unrivaled Strength
1.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 25% and its damage by 125%.

1.name: Brutality
1.description: {highlight}Gain 0.75% attack speed for every 2% missing health. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce Bloodthirst's cooldown by 1 second.{/highlight}

4.name: Indomitable
4.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

4.name: Bull rush
4.description: {highlight}Activate to run in a straigh line after 0.5 seconds, knocking back enemies on contact and healing 10% of his missing health for each target hit.{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: Even tho this gives Garrosh great mobility it's on cost of not getting cleanse also it's on par with the character angry style.
subtexts: Range will be 7.0 | Valla Vault has 5.0 range | Muradin Dwarf Toss has 8.0 range
Missile Speed will be 15 | Valla Vault is 14 | Muradin Dwarf Toss is 30
Cast needs to be finished before being to cast skills

4.name: Groundbreaking tactics
4.description: Activate to make {highlight}Groundbreaker be channeled for up to 2 seconds, increasing the outer area radius by up to 40%. At max channel, pulls enemies instead of stunning.{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: Inspired on Sion Decimating Smash and justify the old garrosh interaction being gatekeeped by maximum channeling and by not picking cleanse
subtexts: You will press the active button and hold it instead of the (Q) button

7.name: Intimidation
7.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds. {highlight}Missing Heroes on the outer radius reduces cooldown by 2 seconds.{/highlight}
7.developerCommentary: This could be considered strong as Intimidation is a niche talent BUT i want you to propositally miss the outer radius sometimes just for attack speed reduction.

7.name: Oppressor
7.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

7.name: Lok-tar ogar!
7.description: {highlight}Into the Fray stuns enemies near the impact for 0.25 seconds. If the target throw is a non-heroic unit, reduces cooldown by 20 seconds.{/highlight}
7.developerCommentary: I want to bring a utility for throwing minions instead of only a mistake.

10.name: Warlord's Challenge
10.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

10.name: Decimate
10.description: Deal 50 damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second. Stores up to 3 charges.

13.name: Defensive Measures
13.description: If Groundbreaker Stuns a Hero, Garrosh gains a 350 Shield for 6 seconds.

13.name: Bloodcraze
13.description: When hitting a Hero, Bloodthirst heals for an additional 15% of Garrosh's maximum Health over 3 seconds.

13.name: Don't let them run
13.description: {highlight}For every second Garrosh stays in combat with enemy heroes he deals 1% more damage up to 10%. When reaching the maximum stacks he shares the bonuses to allied heroes around. The bonus is lost after 4 seconds without combat.{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: One thing that i always wanted was a talent to make Garrosh pursuing better especially on a Decimate focused build

16.name: Mortal Combo
16.description: Hitting a Hero with Groundbreaker's Stun and throwing them with Wrecking Ball within 3 seconds reduces Wrecking Ball's cooldown by 10 seconds, regardless of order.

16.name: Body Check
16.description: Activate to deal 111 (+4% per level) damage to a target. {highlight}If used on an enemy that used dashes within the last 3 seconds will cause 400% more damage and stuns the target for 0.25 seconds while reducing it's cooldown to 4 seconds.{/highlight}
16.developerCommentary: Garrosh is a character that suffers a lot against mobility characters and this talent itself still not make it eazy for Garrosh to deal with this weaklings BUT turns him into a menace if he gets in range and making the kill eazy. After reading some feedback on reddit i came in the Illidan situation as the original version was supposed to be exhaustion i changed it to still be related to dashes but damage focused.

16.name: Seasoned Soldier
16.description: Gain 5% maximum Health, increase Groundbreaker's Slow duration by 1 second, and Bloodthirst gains an additional charge.

20.name: Death Wish
20.description: Increase the duration of Warlord's Challenge by 0.5 seconds. If an enemy Hero is killed while Taunted by Warlord's Challenge, its cooldown is reduced by 45 seconds.

20.name: Deadly Calm
20.description: Heroes hit by Decimate deal 40% less damage for 3 seconds.

20.name: Titanic Might
20.description: Wrecking Ball now throws the 2 closest enemies.

20.name: Gorehowl
20.description: {highlight}After Garrosh uses Groundbreaker, three additional waves are created sequentially from the edge of the original area. Each wave deals 81 damage and stuns enemies for 0.5 seconds. Additional waves are affected by groundbreaking tactics size increase but won't pull the enemies.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: I wanted to empower Groundbreaker somehow and this, this is good. I really like the concept of Angry Garrosh simply destroying the ground angry as he is and it also feels like an level 20 talent.
subtexts: Additional waves are affected by groundbreaking tactics size increase but WILL pull the enemies.
Imagine something close to the Sonya Seismic Slam
